findings.description: The new retry loop around the upstream fetch has no backoff and no attempt cap, so a sustained upstream outage turns into a hot-loop that starves the host of the network budget other work needs (constitution 12.6/12.11). No lint rule or shellcheck check names this pattern -- it requires judging whether the retry strategy is architecturally sound, not matching a known style rule. Recommend extracting the shared bounded-backoff retry helper already used by constitution/scripts/fastcycle/orchestration/handoff.py instead of hand-rolling a new unbounded loop here.
